register.title: Let's set up your Mangora.
register.subtitle: Fill in the essentials and use the full experience for 7 days. On day 8, continue on Free or choose a paid plan.
register.countryHint: Sets the starting market; language and currency stay separate preferences.
register.couponHint: The benefit is applied to the first monthly payment when you subscribe to a plan.
register.passwordRule: Use 8 to 128 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a number.
register.acceptTermsRequired: You need to accept the Terms of Use.
register.acceptPrefix: I have read and agree to the

resetPassword.mismatch: The password confirmation does not match.

resetPassword.subtitle: The link is personal, single-use and expires in 30 minutes. Use an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a number.

support.beforeCopy: Check your connection, refresh the page and confirm that the required fields were filled in.
beforeItems: Do not send passwords or access codes.
List the steps to reproduce the problem.
support.channelsHours: Our support is available Monday to Friday, from 8am to 6pm, Brasília time.
channelsItems: Have the company name and a description of the problem ready.

privacy.metaDescription: Understand how Mangora collects, uses and protects your company data.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: Learn which data we use, why it is needed and which controls are available for your company.

sections.collectedBody: We collect the data provided at sign up and the records needed to deliver the subscribed features.
sections.usageBody: The data is used to authenticate users, deliver features, provide support, improve the experience and protect the platform.
sections.rightsBody: You may request information, correction, portability or deletion of data, subject to applicable legal deadlines and retention duties.

terms.metaDescription: Read the terms and conditions for using the Mangora platform.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.description: These conditions explain the basic rules for using the Mangora platform safely and responsibly.

sections.useBody: By creating an account you state that the information provided is true and that you are authorised to manage the data of the registered company.
sections.availabilityBody: We aim to keep the service available and reliable. Demo features may not persist information while the API integration is not active.
sections.responsibilitiesBody: Mangora assists the business operation but does not replace specialised accounting, tax, legal or financial advice.

recoverPassword.metaDescription: Get the instructions to reset your Mangora account password.
recoverPassword.requestCopy: Enter your account email to receive the password reset instructions.
recoverPassword.error: We could not request the recovery.
recoverPassword.sentSuffix: we will send the recovery instructions.

about.metaDescription: Meet Mangora and our mission to make business management simpler for real businesses.
about.title: Simple management for real businesses
about.description: Mangora was born to bring the essential routines of small and medium businesses into one clear, fast and accessible experience.
about.missionBody: Reduce management complexity so entrepreneurs can spend more time on customers and on growing the business.
about.howBody: We build the platform from everyday flows of sales, stock, customers and finance.

partners.metaDescription: Meet the Mangora partner programme for accountants, consultants, integrators and agencies.
partners.title: Grow together with Mangora
partners.description: We build partnerships with professionals and companies that help businesses sell, organise and grow.
partners.whoBody: Accountants, consultants, integrators, agencies and technology providers can be part of the ecosystem.
partners.nextBody: Send a presentation to parceiros@mangora.com.br with your region, experience and desired partnership model.

security.metaDescription: Learn about the security and data protection practices adopted by Mangora.
security.title: Security at every step
security.description: We apply technical and operational controls to protect accounts, business information and platform availability.
security.accountBody: Access is individual and must use strong, unique credentials.
security.dataBody: We adopt measures proportional to the risk and continuously review our architecture.
security.reportBody: Send details responsibly to seguranca@mangora.com.br. Do not exploit or expose third-party data.
reportItems: Wait for our analysis before disclosing.

lgpd.metaDescription: Learn how Mangora handles personal data and complies with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law.
lgpd.title: Commitment to data protection
lgpd.description: We handle personal data with transparency, defined purpose and measures compatible with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law.
lgpd.rolesBody: Depending on the processing, Mangora may act as controller or processor. Responsibilities are defined by the relationship with the customer.
rolesItems: Collection limited to what is needed.
lgpd.holdersBody: Requests related to personal data can be sent to privacidade@mangora.com.br.
holdersItems: We identify and validate the requester.
We answer within the applicable deadlines.
lgpd.governanceBody: We keep processes to assess risks, suppliers, incidents and relevant changes in data processing.

support.metaDescription: Find help to use Mangora and organise your company operation.
support.title: How can we help?
support.description: Find the channels and key information to answer questions about Mangora.
